# MUS-W-0009

<!-- Generated by `mustur export`. Do not hand-edit: `mustur verify` fails on drift, and the store is the record. -->

**Conformance, against the catalog's own fixtures**

work-unit · 2026-08-20

Discharges: [MUS-M-0003](../milestones.md#mus-m-0003)

Decided by: [MUS-D-0033](../decisions.md#mus-d-0033)

## Context

StrucGu ships a tree per check and an expected.yaml saying what a correct checker produces on each. Running against those is the only evidence available that this is a conforming implementation rather than merely a working one.

## Depends on

MUS-W-0007.

## Discharges

Part of MUS-M-0003: fixtures proving the checks detect something.

## Done means

Every fixture tree in the catalog runs and every state in its expected.yaml is compared, with the number of trees and comparisons reported rather than assumed.\nA fixture directory no expectation names is reported, because a tree nothing asserts about is an unpinned boundary.\nThe one fixture that cannot carry a nested repository is copied elsewhere and its setup run, rather than skipped.\nThe harness runs in CI against a checkout of the catalog, and where no catalog is present it says loudly that it did not run.

## Risks

Conformance is measured against the catalog at the ref CI pins. A module released after that is not covered, and only the drift notice would say so.\nThe fixtures pin what the specification chose to pin. A review found four real divergences in the space they do not cover, which is where two correct-looking checkers still disagree.
